outline: Preserve accepted native-prefix assessment and frozen setup/native boundaries; inspect only changed official metadata claims.
Review author retrieval implementation and exact immutable receipts, provenance, authentication and dependency/support consequences.
Run bounded offline file/Git consistency and preservation checks against the exact clean author freeze; do not repeat broad searches or native discovery.
Commit source-evidence disposition with concise exact external prerequisites, raw failures and explicit unrun gates.

criteria.requirement: Exact PR19 base, allocated new task/report/evidence paths only, prior source and all accepted native-prefix receipts unchanged.

Every new retrieval uses an official supported metadata endpoint with exact requested/final URL, captured bytes/hash, finite bounds and honest errors; no proxy bypass or target package/wheel/archive acquisition.

Signed-release/key/index/package authentication requires exact raw bytes and accepted trust binding. HTTPS, listed checksum, tool-rendered text or detached signature alone is not authentication. UNRUN when unavailable.

Any asserted dependency closure binds exact release/build/package version/architecture/alternatives and all loaders/configuration/extensions; no PGDG/Debian build substitution or guessed metadata from filename.

Supported official channel and extraction mechanism do not establish exact prefix support. Retain conditional relocation and unbound packaging limitations; no unsupported executable setup/launcher claim.

If blocked, name a concise concrete supported metadata-transfer and exact build/layout support prerequisite; no repeated generic discovery, architecture choice, setup action or approval request without an executable bounded packet.
Review exact author freeze/manifest and original raw failures with offline checks only. Distinguish source-evidence acceptance from setup/native/G1 acceptance, and retain cleanup/authority limits.

authorizedReview: read-only source and official metadata assessment
researchPolicy: Reuse prior independently retained primary sources. Additional narrow official reads only if necessary to resolve a new material claim; no repeated broad search.
